why.headline: Why Maldives Legend?
why.intro: More than just a boat. A locally operated Maldives liveaboard experience built around the ocean, the people, and the journey.

points.title: Largest Locally Operated Fleet
points.text: More vessel options and a strong local presence across Maldives.

points.title: High Quality & Well Maintained Fleet
points.text: Comfortable liveaboards designed and maintained for life at sea.

points.title: Professional Local Dive Team
points.text: Experienced local professionals who understand the waters and dive environment.

points.title: Experienced & Excellent Crew
points.text: A crew focused on making the journey comfortable, smooth, and memorable.

points.title: Safety First Policy
points.text: Safety remains a fundamental part of the experience.

activities.title: Four ways to be at sea
activities.intro: Whether you dive, freedive, explore as a mermaid, or simply want to enjoy life at sea, there is a way to experience Maldives with Maldives Legend.

items.title: Scuba
items.text: Drift through channels and reefs, then come home to the dive deck.

items.title: Freedive
items.text: One breath, no tank, just you and the blue.

items.title: Mermaid
items.text: Slip into a tail and swim like you belong here.

items.title: Fun Cruises
items.text: No gear needed. Sun, sea and slow days on board.
